metadata.case_name: TIN WAI SHING AND OTHERS v. TAM FOON LING TRADING AS THE WORLD REFRIGERATION (HONG KONG) CO.

plaintiff.occupation_after: employee at Tai Fat Hong (decoration company) doing cleaning and tidying worksites, moving furniture, transporting materials

injuries.description: Injury to left eye resulting in total visual impairment of the left eye
source: A piece of small metal object had hit his left eye.
On 17 August 1984, a Medical Board had assessed his loss of earning capacity at 30% and he also suffered a total visual impairment of the left eye.
His left eye can now only see with blurred vision.

manifestations.description: His left eye can now only see with blurred vision
has to avoid bright light because that would cause water or tears in the eye
watering or tears in the eye on exposure to bright light
total visual impairment of the left eye
dares not to run across the road because only one eye could see the traffic
cannot play table tennis and snooker which he played before the accident

treatments_received: operation to remove the cataract (11 April)
spectacles as an aid to right eye

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: cannot play table tennis and snooker which he played before the accident

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: dares not to run across the road because only one eye could see the traffic
